body.name: Zhou--Tchetgen Tchetgen finite-partition variance sequence
body.construction: In the binary restriction, partition \((-L,L]\) into \(\mathcal I^{\ell}\), form \(\mathcal P_1^{\ell}=\{h\in\mathcal Q^{\ell}:E_P(h\mid J^{\mathrm{bin}},X)=0\}\), use the Supplement S8.2 conditional-probability basis \((p_1^{\ell},\ldots,p_{\ell-2}^{\ell})\), set \(V^{\ell}=(B_0p_1^{\ell},B_1p_1^{\ell},\ldots,B_0p_{\ell-2}^{\ell},B_1p_{\ell-2}^{\ell})^{\mathsf T}\), and project by \(Q_{\ell}^{\mathrm{ZTT}}f=E_P(fV^{\ell,\mathsf T})\{E_P(V^{\ell}V^{\ell,\mathsf T})\}^{-1}V^{\ell}\)
